comments: // Defaulted Oneof Variant Test (msgid: 226)
// A union member whose type carries schema defaults is materialised eagerly by
// generators that map union members onto nullable references (C#), so it stays
// non-null while a *different* variant is the active one. Serialization must
// therefore pick the payload from the discriminator, never from declaration
// order or property nullability.
// Variant A: carries defaults, so generated code constructs it up front.
leading_comments: // Defaulted Oneof Variant Test (msgid: 226)

// order or property nullability.
// Variant A: carries defaults, so generated code constructs it up front.
DefaultedVariantA.name: DefaultedVariantA
